segments.text: Airplane food sucks, but hey, I got to eat. I keep meals light or skip them entirely on flights. Eating too close to sleep hurts sleep quality and makes jet lag harder to beat. I'll watch a couple movies, you know, they're free. I sleep right after takeoff. Ideally, I can time [music] it with my destination's evening so I can bank sleep and align my circadian rhythm. I'll do a beer or a wine. It helps with the turbulence. I only drink water on flights. Alcohol disrupts your sleep, dehydrates you, and makes jet lag worse. I land, unpack, and then order room service. I stretch and do light exercise when I arrive at the hotel. It helps with alertness and makes
it easier to adjust to the new time zone. You sound like fun. Yeah, well, you eat airplane food. Yeah, well.
